name: AKUA Mind & Body
situation: A multi-location mental health provider needed people to be able to reach its services online.
obstacle: Availability mattered more than features, because patients were finding care through these pages.
decision: Built and maintained the applications on AWS EC2 and Elastic Beanstalk with MySQL, and integrated Salesforce with the VOIP customer-service flow.
result: Reliable access across every location, with search and social integration lifting visibility.
visualAlt: Screenshot of akuamindbody.com, the multi-location mental health provider whose web applications this work built and maintained.
